text:
𝗡𝗭 𝟭𝟱𝟴/𝟳 𝗜𝗡 𝟰𝟭! 😳🇮🇳

New Zealand need 52 more from 9 overs with 3 wickets left, chasing India's 209 in the 5th ODI decider.

India lead 2-1. Who wins it? 👇

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗭 𝟭𝟱𝟴/𝟳, 𝗔𝗕 𝗧𝗔𝗞 𝗞𝗔𝗔𝗡𝗧𝗘 𝗞𝗜 𝗧𝗔𝗞𝗞𝗔𝗥! 😳🇮🇳

👉 India 209 par all out, New Zealand 41 over mein 158/7
👉 NZ ko jeetne ke liye 9 over mein 52 run chahiye, 3 wicket baaki
👉 India 2-1 se aage, NZ jeete toh series 2-2

Kaun jeetega decider? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
